method: Quiet host campaign: no local builds, profiling, repository edits/checkouts or source work during measurements; ordinary desktop background activity uncontrolled. Both binaries factorized_aggregates=true and block_presence_filters=true; only sparse_factor_predicates differs. Three paired original-duration full5M campaigns, AB/BA/AB order. Same immutable SQL source; only sparse_factor_predicates toggles. Fresh server/data load and JVM per case; default text128, eight workers/clients. No builds, profilers or reference database services concurrently.

process_watch.limitations: Periodic image-name inventory can miss short processes, treats any Sig process conservatively, and does not observe every background workload. No process is stopped or reprioritized; no command lines are captured.
